name: Watercolor Wash
summary: A naturalist's field-journal page that paints itself: translucent washes and dry-brush strokes on warm fibrous paper, Cormorant titles, hand-written notes on pen leader lines, one vermilion seal sun.

palette.use: the paper: the only white (never paint white); also the mist that erases
ink: titles, hand notes, leader lines, the darker edge of a form
ink 2: mono labels, stems and branches
vermilion: the seal sun, reserved for that one recurring element
rain blue: the strongest blue wash (scattered blue light, the blue bar)
the seven dry-brush bars across the seal sun
the pale sky wash (from the source's harbour example)
the deeper blue-grey wash: extra passes at the top of a sky, the molecule
the warm dawn wash low in a sky
sunlight strokes, dry grass, the yellow of the spectrum
hills, and green in the spectrum

type.case: sentence case; spaced caps for mono labels
type.emphasis: italic in the same ink; the hand note; the one accent

banned: vector outlines: every edge is a brush edge (a darker stroke along a form is the only line)
pure white paint: the paper is the white
darker pigment for depth: darker means more passes
more than 3–5 hues in a scene, plus ink
continuous colour ramps: quantise into 4–6 bands
hard cuts or dissolves between unrelated pictures: brush-edge wipes, mist, a page turn or the camera
ink wash, impasto, crayon or cute outlines; a watercolour texture laid over vector art
anything jittering or stepping; unseeded randomness
copying a specific artwork, character or layout

sources.what: Lemo-Opuscar style No. 02 "Watercolor" (Watercolor Field Journal / Watercolor Brush): STYLE.md, DEMO.md, style.json, demo film "Follow the Rain"
sources.where: github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar styles/watercolor; research notes docs/research/styles/five-skills.md, "Watercolor Field Journal (lib: Watercolor Brush)"
